items: Trial switches for skill in fights, home island creatures first. ?skill=1: wild creatures pause after they attack, letters wear down their poise until they stagger and slow down, and open creatures glint amber. ?commands=1: the creature at the bottom of your stack acts on Command (pad square, F, middle mouse, touch's act button), each use spending one of its berry pips; circle picks up and places on the pad, and square eats near a berry
